_comment: Shape-1 Beacon system-caller policy. Lives in the Beacon account (agentops-consumer, 172873868821). This is the REACHABILITY gate: the ONLY thing that lets Beacon reach COA serve. Groups are NOT here — IAM has no groups concept that reaches serve; Beacon asserts profile.groups in the invoke payload and serve trusts it BECAUSE only this role can make the call. So this policy is the real security boundary: scope it to exactly the one serve runtime endpoint, nothing wider.

Statement._resource_note: Scope to the ENDPOINT ARN (.../runtime-endpoint/DEFAULT), not the bare runtime ARN — the invoke targets the endpoint (cross-account AgentCore lesson). <RUNTIME_ID> is filled once the IAM-authorized serve runtime is deployed.

Statement._deny_note: AWS best practice: a workload that never carries a user JWT should explicitly deny the ForUser path, so all identity goes through the one system profile this role asserts — it cannot be coaxed into impersonating an end user.
